description: Header file defining structures, function prototypes, and callback types for the 'angel' plugin system in the lighttpd server project.

methods.name: li_plugins_init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin system with module directory and residency option.

methods.name: li_plugins_clear
methods.description: Clears and deinitializes the plugin system.

methods.name: li_plugins_config_load
methods.description: Loads plugin configuration from a specified file.

methods.name: li_plugins_stop
methods.description: Stops all plugin activities and unloads plugins.

methods.name: li_plugins_handle_item
methods.description: Handles a plugin item with given parameters.

methods.name: li_plugins_load_module
methods.description: Loads a plugin module by name.

methods.name: li_angel_plugin_register
methods.description: Registers a new angel plugin with initialization callback.

methods.name: li_angel_plugin_add_angel_cb
methods.description: Adds a callback for a specific angel event to a plugin.

methods.name: li_angel_plugin_replaced_instance
methods.description: Handles notification of plugin instance replacement.

methods.name: li_angel_plugin_instance_reached_state
methods.description: Handles notification when a plugin instance reaches a specific state.
